verdict.rationale: YYLO's core CLI workflow does let users delegate tasks to an AI agent via `--subagent claude` and `yy pi` prompts (yylo-docs-1, yylo-docs-18, yylo-docs-29), but the 'assistant' is an external agent (e.g. Claude) invoked through the CLI, not a first-party built-in assistant native to YYLO itself. Missing for 10: evidence of a proprietary/native YYLO assistant (vs. orchestrating third-party subagents), and any UI/chat surface for direct assistant interaction.
